items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: In fact, Ben Bart booked us on that.

ctx.x: 'Hands Off,' yes, it was, yes. And in fact, that was the first time I had went out on the road, since coming to Kansas City in 1951. I came to Kansas City the year of the flood in '51, and then I decided, I said, well, I better get a place here, because the kids will have to go to school somewhere. And so I just sort of went back and settled in Kansas City. And after the kids got of age, about four or five, then she started school and then I ran into Priscilla and we did this Hands Off thing, and '55 I went on…

In fact, Ben Bart booked us on that. And then I came on back into Kansas City, because I would get on those jobs and stay there four, five years. Because when I went back in '51 I stayed there until '55 on that job.
